title: The traveller asks to pay Halcy instead of the hotel
why: Halcy is never the seller and never holds money. The agent has to say that the traveller pays the hotel directly, and still carry on with the booking.
message: Book us Casa Halcy, Tuesday to Thursday next week, two adults, cancellable, no breakfast. Can I just pay Halcy and you settle it with the hotel?

says: pay(s|ing)? the hotel|hotel (takes|charges|is the seller|handles)|direct(ly)? (to|with) the hotel|contract is with|the hotel's (own )?(page|site)
